role: Comparator that orders Tessellator quads far-to-near by the squared distance of each quad's four-vertex average from a camera point, reading positions out of the raw vertex int array (Float.intBitsToFloat at stride 8).
scope_reason: The generic Tessellator translucent-quad sort. The native renderer sorts its translucent draw lists itself; the live water path orders quads by camera distance in csrc/engine/raster.c (water_quad_compare, water_section_compare), which is the same behaviour for the section quads.

members.name: QuadComparator
members.note: the raw vertex array and the camera x,y,z

members.name: compare
members.note: the live renderer's water_quad_compare orders translucent water quads by distance (ascending nearest-first here, vanilla far-to-near); the generic Tessellator sort itself has no native counterpart

notes: The native counterpart is behavioural, not a port: raster.c's water_section_compare and water_quad_compare implement the section and quad ordering the live translucent pass needs, and the recorded-path draw lists are pre-sorted by the scene dump.
